Looking at panel A, the three activation curves are shifted horizontally relative to each other. The blue curve (ASAP1) begins its descent from 1.0 at the most negative voltages and therefore intersects the 0.5 dashed line furthest to the left (lowest command voltage). The magenta (ASAP2s) and green (ASAP3) curves cross the 0.5 line at progressively higher (more positive) command voltages.

Thus, ASAP1 reaches 50% of (F−Fmin)/(Fmax−Fmin) at the lowest command voltage.

[ANSWER]E[/ANSWER]
